messages:
jamie_csm: quick heads-up — Ridgeway Ops is expanding. They want to spin up 4 new product squads and a realtime summarization pipeline that hits our API for contextual highlights. saw a staging spike this morning, not yet in prod.

alex_cs: do we have numbers on qps / token volume?

jamie_csm: rough from staging: peak ~420 qps sustained for 6m, avg token length ~380. they said goal is 1k qps within 3 weeks.

mike_se: wow. 1k qps with 380 tokens each is nontrivial. any plan to use dedupe/caching? can they start with smaller model variant for lower cost?

olivia_pm: Ridgeway's timeline: pilot next week, org-wide in 3 weeks. they're committed if infra looks ok. asking for Dedicated pilot or burst capacity.

jamie_csm: asked them to share a sampling of prompts — they already sent a 50k sample set. uploading to the sandbox for eval.

alex_cs: ok please run the sample through our perf harness and send perf/cost estimate. tag me.

mike_se: quick checklist I'm pulling together:
- validate model variant accuracy on their prompts
- run batch vs streaming latency tests
- evaluate KV/prefix caching hit rate
- estimate GPU pods needed for 1k qps (slo 100ms p50 for short responses)

jamie_csm: copying our playbook snippet I sent Ridgeway (they liked the checklist):

```
# onboarding-playbook excerpt
1) sandbox ingest (50k prompts) -> run evals
2) perf sweep: batch sizes [4,8,16], kv-cache enabled
3) cost projection: per-token + infra reserve
4) canary: 10% traffic -> monitor errors/latency/cost
```

olivia_pm: also flagged renewal risk if performance doesn't meet SLA. renewal in 6 months, but they said expansion depends on this pilot.

jamie_csm: action items: alex run perf harness by EOD Thu; mike estimate pod count + fallback variants; i'll schedule a 30m sync with Ridgeway CSM + infra on Fri. i'll share the sample location: gs://redwood-ridgeway/samples/50k.tar.gz

alex_cs: starting the harness now. will post results as a table in this thread. :mag_right:

mike_se: thinking about quick mitigations — suggest we pre-create an autoscale burst pool and enable an interim quantized model for non-critical traffic. saves cost and buys headroom.

jamie_csm: tagged deploy-bot for the burst pool request.

deploy-bot: @jamie_csm request received. Provisioning a temporary burst pool (GPU reserve) for customer ridgeway-ops. ETA ~2h for initial capacity. :gear:

olivia_pm: perfect. also capture feedback from their SREs during canary — want to know any observability gaps.

jamie_csm: noted. i'll include a short feedback form in the canary invite.

alex_cs: results: initial harness run shows p50 token gen 78ms, p95 420ms at 200 qps. batch size 8 had best cost/latency tradeoff. sharing numbers in the doc.

mike_se: with those numbers we're looking at ~5 dedicated pods to hit 1k qps with our latency SLO (assuming continuous batching + 16GB KV). I'll prepare the config diffs.

jamie_csm: great. scheduling sync for Fri 10am PT. invite sent to Ridgeway SRE, product lead, and our infra oncall.

olivia_pm: thanks team — high priority for CS + PM. keeping renewal watch flagged. :eyes:

jamie_csm: closing loop: i'll keep this thread updated with harness artifacts and the canary plan. any blockers shout here. :thumbsup:
